#!/bin/bash

currentdir=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")"; pwd)

localip=`ip a|grep inet|grep -v 127.0.0.1|grep -v inet6|awk '{print $2}'|awk -F'/' '{print $1}'`
echo "服务器IP："$localip
port=`grep port config.json |grep "|awk -F':' '{print $2}'|grep "|awk -F'"' '{print $2}'`
echo "端口："$port

source /etc/profile
nohup node $currentdir/vendors/server/app.js >/dev/null 2>&1 &

yapinum=`ps -ef|grep vendors/server/app.js|grep -v grep|awk '{print $2}'|wc -l`
while [[ 1 != $yapinum ]]; do
	yapinum=`ps -ef|grep vendors/server/app.js|grep -v grep|awk '{print $2}'|wc -l`
	echo "等待yapi服务启动"
	sleep 5
done

java -jar ../sliceTool/SliceTool.jar ice2yapi $localip:$port

TITLE %PACKAGE_NAME%
if "%1" neq "" (

) else (
  start /b %JAVAW_CMD% -jar "%ROOT_DIR%\lib\%PACKAGE_NAME%" 
)
exit
::CALL java -jar "%ROOT_DIR%\lib\%PACKAGE_NAME%"

POPD

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
@echo off

set server_ip=%1
set server_user=%2
set server_pwd=%3
set install_path=%4
set cusaplatform_user_dir=%5
set upload_folder=%6
set cusaplatform_root_path=%~d0
set cusaagent_folder=CusaDeployAgent
echo "cusaplatform_root_path is: " %cusaplatform_root_path%
echo "cusaplatform_user_dir is: " %cusaplatform_user_dir%

cd /d %~dp0
:: D:\software\CusaAllInOne\Cusaplatform	hirdparty
set local_folder=%cusaplatform_user_dir%	hirdparty\%upload_folder%
:: set remote_folder= .170.90.218\D$\CusaDeployAgent
set remote_folder=\%server_ip%\%install_path%$\%cusaagent_folder%
echo "local_folder path: " %local_folder%
echo "remote_folder path: " %remote_folder%
:: D:\software\CusaAllInOne\Cusaplatform\log
set log_file_path=%cusaplatform_user_dir%\log
echo %cd%
echo "-----set args finished!-----"

:: if exist %cd%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win.log del %cd%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win.log /f /s /q /a
if exist %log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log del /F /S /Q %log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log

if not exist %local_folder% (
    echo "error: %local_folder% not exist"
    echo "%local_folder% not exist">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)

net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user%
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo " error: net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user% is fail"
    echo "net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user% is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
@echo "-----connect successed!-----"

if exist %remote_folder% (
    echo "%remote_folder% is exist, call stop.bat and delete %remote_folder%"
    %cusaplatform_user_dir%	hirdparty\WMIC.exe /node:%server_ip% /user:%server_user% /password:%server_pwd% process call create "cmd /c %install_path%:\%cusaagent_folder%\service\stop.bat"
    ping %server_ip% -n 30 >nul
    rd /S /Q %remote_folder%
)


xcopy %local_folder% %remote_folder% /D /E /Y /H /K /R /I
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo "error: xcopy %local_folder% to %remote_folder% is fail"
    echo "xcopy %local_folder% to %remote_folder% is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
if not exist %remote_folder% (
    echo "error: %remote_folder% is not exist"
    echo "%remote_folder% is not exist">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
echo "-----xcopy %local_folder% to %remote_folder% finished!-----"


if exist %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip% (
    rd /S /Q %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%
) else (
    md %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%
)
CALL %local_folder%\service\create-cusaagentxml.bat %server_ip% %install_path%:\%cusaagent_folder%
if not exist %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml (
    echo "error: create %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml is fail"
    echo "create %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)

if exist %remote_folder%\service\cusa-agent.xml del /S /Q %remote_folder%\service\cusa-agent.xml /f /s /q /a

copy %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml \%server_ip%\%4$\%cusaagent_folder%\service\ /y
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo "error: %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml to \%server_ip%\%4$\CusaDeployAgent\service\ is fail"
    echo "%local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml to \%server_ip%\%4$\CusaDeployAgent\service\ is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
rd /S /Q %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%

net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ /delete
echo "-----delete connect successed!-----"

%cusaplatform_user_dir%	hirdparty\WMIC.exe /node:%server_ip% /user:%server_user% /password:%server_pwd% process call create "cmd /c D:\CusaDeployAgent\service\start.bat"
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    set error_msg="call start.bat is fail"
    echo %error_msg%
    echo %error_msg%>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
@echo "-----install cusaagent successed!
exit /b 0

:ERROREXIT
exit /b 1

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

#current_path=$(dirname $(readlink -f "$0"))
#thirdparty_path=$(dirname $(dirname $current_path))/thirdparty
#定时任务是通过cron.service文件执行的，当前目录变更为根目录了，所以这里采取在安装nginx的时候记录nginx的路径
nginx_home=$(cat /usr/nginx_home)
days=7
LOGS_PATH=$nginx_home/logs
 
NEWLOGS_PATH=$LOGS_PATH/history

if [ ! -d "$NEWLOGS_PATH" ];then
	mkdir $NEWLOGS_PATH
fi
 
YESTERDAY=$(date -d "yesterday" +%Y%m%d)
 

mv ${LOGS_PATH}/access.log ${NEWLOGS_PATH}/access_${YESTERDAY}.log
 
/bin/kill -SIGUSR1 $(cat $nginx_home/nginx.pid)

find $NEWLOGS_PATH/ -mtime +$days -delete

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#! /bin/bash

main(){
curl=`curl --version 2> /dev/null`
wget=`wget --version 2> /dev/null`
if [ "${curl#*"curl"}" != "$curl" ]; then
       downloader="curl"
elif [ "${wget#*"Wget"}" != "$wget" ]; then
       downloader="wget"
else
       echo "Please instll curl or wget"
       exit 1
fi

vscp_dir="/usr/local/vscp"
if [ ! -f "$vscp_dir/vscp_uninstall.sh" ];then
       sh $vscp_dir/vscp_uninstall.sh
fi
sleep  1
if [ ! -d "$vscp_dir" ];then
       mkdir $vscp_dir
fi

if [ "$downloader"=="curl" ];then
	 curl -o $vscp_dir/k8s-vm-client http://10.190.160.90:30001/api/v1/vm/deploy/k8s-vm-client
else
	 wget -O $vscp_dir/k8s-vm-client http://10.190.160.90:30001/api/v1/vm/deploy/k8s-vm-client
fi

echo -e "#?/bin/bash
$vscp_dir/k8s-vm-client 10.190.160.90:8848 > $vscp_dir/run.log &" > $vscp_dir/vscp_start.sh

echo -e "#?/bin/bash
systemctl stop vscp
rm -f /usr/lib/systemd/system/vscp.service
rm -f /lib/systemd/system/vscp.service
rm -rf /usr/local/vscp
systemctl daemon-reload" > $vscp_dir/vscp_uninstall.sh

echo -e "[Unit]
Description=vscp client
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=forking
ExecStart=/bin/bash -c $vscp_dir/vscp_start.sh
ExecReload=
ExecStop=/bin/bash -c  ps -ef|grep k8s-vm-client |grep -v grep |awk '{print \$2}'

PrivateTmp=True

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target" > /lib/systemd/system/vscp.service

chmod -R 777 $vscp_dir

iptables -t nat -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 8000 -j ACCEPT
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable vscp
systemctl start vscp

}
main

record.rsp_body:
@echo off

set server_ip=%1
set server_user=%2
set server_pwd=%3
set install_path=%4
set cusaplatform_user_dir=%5
set upload_folder=%6
set cusaplatform_root_path=%~d0
set cusaagent_folder=CusaDeployAgent
set start_bat_path=%install_path%:\%cusaagent_folder%\service\start.bat

echo "cusaplatform_root_path is: " %cusaplatform_root_path%
echo "cusaplatform_user_dir is: " %cusaplatform_user_dir%
echo "start_bat_path is: " %start_bat_path%

cd /d %~dp0
:: D:\software\CusaAllInOne\Cusaplatform	hirdparty
set local_folder=%cusaplatform_user_dir%	hirdparty\%upload_folder%
:: set remote_folder= .170.90.218\D$\CusaDeployAgent
set remote_folder=\%server_ip%\%install_path%$\%cusaagent_folder%
echo "local_folder path: " %local_folder%
echo "remote_folder path: " %remote_folder%
:: D:\software\CusaAllInOne\Cusaplatform\log
set log_file_path=%cusaplatform_user_dir%\log
echo %cd%
echo "-----set args finished!-----"

:: if exist %cd%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win.log del %cd%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win.log /f /s /q /a
if exist %log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log del /F /S /Q %log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log

if not exist %local_folder% (
    echo "error: %local_folder% not exist"
    echo "%local_folder% not exist">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)

net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ /delete
ping %server_ip% -n 10 >nul
net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user%
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo "error: net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user% is fail"
    echo "error: net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user% is fail: ">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user%>>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log 2>&1
    goto ERROREXIT
)
@echo "-----connect successed!-----"

if exist %remote_folder% (
    echo "%remote_folder% is exist, delete %remote_folder%"
    rd /S /Q %remote_folder%
    ping %server_ip% -n 10 >nul
)

xcopy %local_folder% %remote_folder% /D /E /Y /H /K /R /I
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo "error: xcopy %local_folder% %remote_folder% /D /E /Y /H /K /R /I is fail"
    echo "xcopy %local_folder% %remote_folder% /D /E /Y /H /K /R /I is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
if not exist %remote_folder% (
    echo "error: %remote_folder% is not exist"
    echo "%remote_folder% is not exist">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
echo "-----xcopy %local_folder% to %remote_folder% finished!-----"


if exist %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip% (
    rd /S /Q %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%
) else (
    md %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%
)
CALL %local_folder%\service\create-cusaagentxml.bat %server_ip% %install_path%:\%cusaagent_folder%
if not exist %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml (
    echo "error: create %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml is fail"
    echo "create %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)

if exist %remote_folder%\service\cusa-agent.xml del /S /Q %remote_folder%\service\cusa-agent.xml /f /s /q /a

copy %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml \%server_ip%\%4$\%cusaagent_folder%\service\ /y
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo "error: copy %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml \%server_ip%\%4$\%cusaagent_folder%\service\ /y is fail"
    echo "copy %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml \%server_ip%\%4$\%cusaagent_folder%\service\ /y is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
rd /S /Q %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%

net use \%server_ip% /delete
echo "-----delete connect successed!-----"

@echo "-----install cusaagent successed!
exit /b 0

:ERROREXIT
exit /b 1

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/sh

# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.

case $1 in
    producer)

    pid=`ps ax | grep -i 'org.apache.rocketmq.example.benchmark.Producer' |grep java | grep -v grep | awk '{print $1}'`
    if [ -z "$pid" ] ; then
            echo "No benchmark producer running."
            exit -1;
    fi

    echo "The benchmark producer(${pid}) is running..."

    kill ${pid}

    echo "Send shutdown request to benchmark producer(${pid}) OK"
    ;;
    consumer)

    pid=`ps ax | grep -i 'org.apache.rocketmq.example.benchmark.Consumer' |grep java | grep -v grep | awk '{print $1}'`
    if [ -z "$pid" ] ; then
            echo "No benchmark consumer running."
            exit -1;
    fi

    echo "The benchmark consumer(${pid}) is running..."

    kill ${pid}

    echo "Send shutdown request to benchmark consumer(${pid}) OK"
    ;;
    tproducer)

    pid=`ps ax | grep -i 'org.apache.rocketmq.example.benchmark.TransactionProducer' |grep java | grep -v grep | awk '{print $1}'`
    if [ -z "$pid" ] ; then
            echo "No benchmark transaction producer running."
            exit -1;
    fi

    echo "The benchmark transaction producer(${pid}) is running..."

    kill ${pid}

    echo "Send shutdown request to benchmark transaction producer(${pid}) OK"
    ;;
    bproducer)

    pid=`ps ax | grep -i 'org.apache.rocketmq.example.benchmark.BatchProducer' |grep java | grep -v grep | awk '{print $1}'`
    if [ -z "$pid" ] ; then
            echo "No benchmark batch producer running."
            exit -1;
    fi

    echo "The benchmark batch producer(${pid}) is running..."

    kill ${pid}

    echo "Send shutdown request to benchmark batch producer(${pid}) OK"
    ;;
    *)
    echo "Usage: shutdown producer | consumer | tproducer | bproducer"
esac
